opening.intro1: On the edge of Crystal City, there stood one big building...
The plate hanging under the eaves said: {player}'s House...
That's right. I'm {player}, the owner of this house.
One day, I started wanting to live happily in one house together with my friends.
And so this house was built... {player}'s House.
My friends live happily in this house. Only three of them show up in this game, but really there are lots and lots more.
Today, like always, I got up early, took on the final boss of an RPG with my half-asleep brain, got totally crushed, and out of rage at myself and extreme embarrassment, I instinctively let out a
opening.intro2: Everyone in the house, woken up by that scream, was now eating breakfast.
They're all grumbling and complaining about my scream.
opening.breakfast: Friend 1: Seriously, what was that scream about?
{player}: The demon lord in my RPG crushed me. Totally unfair.
{player}: I guess my level was too low.
{player}: Sadly, you can't open the cheat panel during a battle.
Friend 1: Anyway, we're sleeping, so cut it out.
Friend 3: You little...! What do you mean, nope?! I'll cut your food rations!
{player}: But I'm the one who does almost all the cooking.
Friend 3: Heh, all you ever do is make toast.
Everyone: Ha ha ha ha ha!
opening.raid1: Someone: Hey hey hey! Hand over the food!
Someone: Huh? You don't even know what food means? How low-level can you get?
{player}: But this is somebody's house, you know?
Someone: Shut up! Hand it over already!
opening.raid2: You barge into somebody's house without asking, and you think you can talk like that?
Someone: Huh? What are you babbling about?
{player}: Don't play dumb! If you can't even get by without stealing food from people's houses, you guys are way too low-level!
Someone: Ohhh! Saying that to the great me? You wanna die?
{player}: Huh? No, I don't wanna die.
Someone: Huh... well, I guess barging in with three of us at once was a bad idea. Okay, we're going home. Seeee ya!
Friend 3: Hey, he's right! You jerks, get back heeeere!
opening.raid3: Friend 3: What's with those stupid jerks?
opening.next_days: The next day, and the day after that, the weird guys attacked again. Looking for food.
opening.breakfast2: Someone: Hey! Let me join your breakfast too!
{player}: Nope! You can have a plate, though!
opening.throwing: Someone: Owww! You'll pay for that!
After that, we threw all kinds of stuff at them, over and over.
Someone: You guys! Even if you take us out, this isn't over! You'll remember thiiis!
opening.dream: Person 2: Darn it... I'm so hungry...
Person 4: What's going to happen to us...
Person 5: G... give me back my daughter...
Someone: Hwaaa ha ha ha ha ha ha!
All the food belongs to us and...
opening.journey: Friend 3: Huh? Don't joke around. A journey? You could die, you know. And it's got nothing to do with us.
Friend 2: That's right. There's no reason you have to go.
I had a dream last night.
I don't really get it, but I feel like food is going to end up out of our reach.
Friend 3: Shut up! We're worried about you, and that's what you say?!
{player}: Look who's talking! Why are you stopping me? I'm going because I'm worried about you guys!
You guys have your own lives.
Even if I die, you can still live.
Because I want you to live your precious lives as hard as you can...!
And so, my adventure began... But nobody knew yet that it would turn into a journey no one could have imagined...
